from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

# Let's inspect obs_0001, obs_0015, obs_0016, obs_0018, obs_0019
# We have 8 objects:
# 1. vase (blue)
# 2. stool (brown circular top, dark legs)
# 3. table (brown rectangular table with 4 legs)
# 4. cabinet (white top, light brown front)
# 5. sofa (dark grey)
# 6. chair (brown chair with backrest)
# 7. floor_lamp (yellow shade, dark grey stem/base)
# 8. potted_plant (green leaves, brown/terracotta pot)

# Let's write functions to segment each object and find their ground contact points.

im1 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0001.png'))
im15 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0015.png'))
im16 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0016.png'))
im18 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0018.png'))
im19 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0019.png'))

def get_stats(mask, name):
    coords = np.argwhere(mask)
    if len(coords) == 0:
        print(f"{name}: not found")
        return None
    vmin, vmax = coords[:,0].min(), coords[:,0].max()
    umin, umax = coords[:,1].min(), coords[:,1].max()
    ucen = (umin + umax) / 2.0
    print(f"{name}: v=[{vmin}, {vmax}], u=[{umin}, {umax}], ucen={ucen:.1f}")
    return vmin, vmax, umin, umax, ucen

# Stool in im1:
# Legs are dark grey (around [80, 80, 85]), top is brown [150, 75, 25]
# Let's find brown top:
stool_top_m1 = (im1[:,:,0] > 120) & (im1[:,:,0] < 170) & (im1[:,:,1] > 60) & (im1[:,:,1] < 90) & (im1[:,:,2] < 40) & (im1[:,:,1] > im1[:,:,2])
print("--- Stool top in obs1 ---")
get_stats(stool_top_m1, "stool_top_1")

# Stool legs in im1:
stool_legs_m1 = (im1[:,:,0] > 70) & (im1[:,:,0] < 100) & (im1[:,:,1] > 70) & (im1[:,:,1] < 100) & (im1[:,:,2] > 75) & (im1[:,:,2] < 110)
# restrict to around u in [190, 240], v in [300, 340]
stool_legs_m1 &= (np.arange(512)[None, :] > 190) & (np.arange(512)[None, :] < 240) & (np.arange(512)[:, None] > 300)
print("--- Stool legs in obs1 ---")
get_stats(stool_legs_m1, "stool_legs_1")

# Stool legs in im15 (cam at (0, 1.5, yaw=0)):
stool_legs_m15 = (im15[:,:,0] > 70) & (im15[:,:,0] < 100) & (im15[:,:,1] > 70) & (im15[:,:,1] < 100) & (im15[:,:,2] > 75) & (im15[:,:,2] < 110)
stool_legs_m15 &= (np.arange(512)[None, :] > 150) & (np.arange(512)[None, :] < 250) & (np.arange(512)[:, None] > 320)
print("--- Stool legs in obs15 ---")
get_stats(stool_legs_m15, "stool_legs_15")

# Table in im1:
# Brown table is to the right: u > 300
table_m1 = (im1[:,:,0] > 110) & (im1[:,:,0] < 160) & (im1[:,:,1] > 50) & (im1[:,:,1] < 85) & (im1[:,:,2] < 35) & (np.arange(512)[None, :] > 320)
print("--- Table in obs1 ---")
get_stats(table_m1, "table_1")

table_m15 = (im15[:,:,0] > 110) & (im15[:,:,0] < 160) & (im15[:,:,1] > 50) & (im15[:,:,1] < 85) & (im15[:,:,2] < 35) & (np.arange(512)[None, :] > 320)
print("--- Table in obs15 ---")
get_stats(table_m15, "table_15")

# Cabinet in im1:
# White top [220+, 220+, 220+], brown doors
cab_top_m1 = (im1[:,:,0] > 200) & (im1[:,:,1] > 200) & (im1[:,:,2] > 200) & (np.arange(512)[:, None] > 290)
print("--- Cabinet top in obs1 ---")
get_stats(cab_top_m1, "cab_top_1")

cab_all_m1 = (np.arange(512)[:, None] > 295) & (np.arange(512)[None, :] > 280) & (np.arange(512)[None, :] < 360) & (im1[:,:,0] > 100)
get_stats(cab_all_m1, "cab_all_1")

# Floor lamp in im16:
# Cam pos is (0.5, 1.5), yaw = 90 (looking along +x)
# Lamp shade is yellow, base is dark grey circle on floor
lamp_base_m16 = (im16[:,:,0] > 60) & (im16[:,:,0] < 90) & (im16[:,:,1] > 65) & (im16[:,:,1] < 95) & (im16[:,:,2] > 75) & (im16[:,:,2] < 105) & (np.arange(512)[:, None] > 400)
print("--- Lamp base in obs16 ---")
get_stats(lamp_base_m16, "lamp_base_16")

# Plant pot in im16:
# Terracotta pot is on the left
pot_m16 = (im16[:,:,0] > 140) & (im16[:,:,1] < 80) & (np.arange(512)[:, None] > 350) & (np.arange(512)[None, :] < 60)
print("--- Pot in obs16 ---")
get_stats(pot_m16, "pot_16")

# Plant in im1:
plant_m1 = (im1[:,:,0] > 140) & (im1[:,:,1] < 80) & (np.arange(512)[None, :] > 400)
print("--- Pot in obs1 ---")
get_stats(plant_m1, "pot_1")

# Chair in im18 and im19:
# obs18: cam at (0.0, 2.0), yaw = 270 (looking along -x)
chair_m18 = (im18[:,:,0] > 100) & (im18[:,:,0] < 160) & (im18[:,:,1] > 50) & (im18[:,:,1] < 85) & (im18[:,:,2] < 40)
print("--- Chair in obs18 ---")
get_stats(chair_m18, "chair_18")

chair_m19 = (im19[:,:,0] > 100) & (im19[:,:,0] < 160) & (im19[:,:,1] > 50) & (im19[:,:,1] < 85) & (im19[:,:,2] < 40)
print("--- Chair in obs19 ---")
get_stats(chair_m19, "chair_19")

# Sofa in im18 and im19:
# Sofa is dark grey [70-100, 80-110, 95-125]
sofa_m18 = (im18[:,:,2] > 90) & (im18[:,:,2] < 140) & (im18[:,:,0] < 90) & (np.arange(512)[None, :] > 300)
print("--- Sofa in obs18 ---")
get_stats(sofa_m18, "sofa_18")

sofa_m19 = (im19[:,:,2] > 90) & (im19[:,:,2] < 140) & (im19[:,:,0] < 90) & (np.arange(512)[None, :] > 300)
print("--- Sofa in obs19 ---")
get_stats(sofa_m19, "sofa_19")
